daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving 'creative breakthrough energy' today. The cosmos is nudging you toward bold ideas and authentic self-expression. Trust that magnetizing pull you're feeling—it's real and it matters.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, today's about vulnerability wearing its coolest fit. Someone might surprise you with how deeply they listen. Let your guard down just a little—connection is waiting on the other side.
daily.career: Your perspective shift today could actually move mountains. You're seeing angles others aren't, and that's your superpower right now. Share those unconventional ideas—the right people are ready to hear them.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and presence today. Even 15 minutes of whatever feels good—dancing, walking, stretching—will recalibrate your whole energy. Listen to what brings you joy, not what feels like a chore.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your sector of self-discovery this week, aquarius. You're basically getting a cosmic permission slip to lean into your weirdness and let your freak flag fly. The energy feels lighter, more playful. Trust the vibe shift.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering something about vulnerability being your actual superpower rn. Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is peak energy for showing up authentically. Stop overthinking and just... feel? The connections that matter will feel different.
weekly.career: Your professional momentum is building quietly behind the scenes. Small wins are adding up into something real. This week's about planting seeds rather than harvesting—keep showing up, keep iterating. Your future self is gonna be impressed with present you.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more play and less pressure. Movement that feels good rather than looks good is calling to you. Whether it's dancing, walking, or just vibing differently with your physical self, honor what actually energizes you instead of what should.
